title: Reussite
summary: REUS'SITE, noun [from Reuss, the place where it is found.] A salt found in the form of a mealy efforescence, or crystallized in flat six sided prisms, and in acicular crystals.

inlines.v: REUS'SITE, noun [from Reuss, the place where it is found.] A salt found in the form of a mealy efforescence, or crystallized in flat six sided prisms, and in acicular crystals.
